mainEntity.name: What are the main phases of a home expansion project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The home expansion process begins with an initial consultation to assess your space, clarify your goals, and establish feasibility. Next, architectural plans are drawn and submitted for municipal building permits. Once permits are approved, site preparation and foundation work begin, followed by structural framing, roofing, and weatherproofing to tie the new structure into your home. Mechanical trades install electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems before drywall installation and finishing take place. Finally, interior trim, paint, fixtures, and exterior finishes like stucco are completed before final inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: The phases include consultation, design and permitting, foundation and framing, mechanical installations, drywall and interior finishes, exterior blending, and final inspection.
